requested_result: Runtime 通用支持已准入的 tool-free 与 tool-enabled Execution Profile，并提供 Workflow graph authoring class；同一 immutable Workflow export 可以原样注册到多个独立 Runtime Registry。

interface_contracts.input: ModuleRegistrationSource plus exact Behavior, Evaluation, Retry and optional Execution Profile releases
interface_contracts.output: ModuleExport containing one dependency-closed Module release bundle; when the optional Profile is absent, the export has no Profile or Variant and carries MODULE_EXECUTION_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE; an incompatible supplied Profile produces no ModuleExport

interface_contracts.input: one immutable tuple of Module declared operation IDs
interface_contracts.output: exactly one model operation ID plus the exact non-model operation set

interface_contracts.input: Module declared operations and compatible transports plus one exact ExecutionProfileRelease
interface_contracts.output: validated profile binding eligible for ExecutionVariantPolicy compilation

interface_contracts.input: repository-independent WorkflowReleaseCandidate plus exact ModuleExport values referenced by graph nodes
interface_contracts.output: Workflow authoring object with exact graph and dependency closure
WorkflowExport containing one WorkflowRelease and a canonical dependency-closed origin RuntimeReleaseBundle; Execution Profile and Execution Variant Policy releases are intentionally excluded
one immutable registration result per target Runtime Registry
interface_contracts.effects: atomic mutation of the selected Registry only

error_contracts.condition: Module declared_operation_ids contain zero or more than one model invocation operation
error_contracts.meaning: Runtime produces no ModuleExport and does not evaluate Profile compatibility
error_contracts.caller_action: correct the Module operation declaration and retry authoring; ModuleAuthoringError exposes this exact error_code

error_contracts.condition: caller requests an executable Module export without an ExecutionProfileRelease
error_contracts.meaning: Module release content can compile, but no executable Variant binding was produced
error_contracts.caller_action: supply one exact registered profile or keep the export non-executable

error_contracts.condition: profile transport is incompatible, profile tools differ from Module non-model operations, or the profile grants undeclared tools
error_contracts.meaning: Runtime produces neither ModuleExport nor Execution Variant binding for this supplied Module and Profile pair
error_contracts.caller_action: select or compile a Profile whose exact capabilities match the Module declaration; ModuleAuthoringError exposes this exact error_code

error_contracts.condition: a Module graph node lacks one exact matching ModuleExport ref and hash, supplied Module exports are outside the graph closure, or two supplied exports carry the same release ref with different bytes
error_contracts.meaning: WorkflowExport and dependency-closed bundle were not produced
error_contracts.caller_action: supply exactly the Module exports referenced by the graph and retry authoring

error_contracts.condition: execution_binding_ref is not derived from Workflow identity/version, or execution_binding_document differs from the exact target-independent workflow_execution_binding_v1 shape
error_contracts.meaning: WorkflowExport and WorkflowRelease were not produced
error_contracts.caller_action: supply the exact target-independent binding descriptor and retry authoring

error_contracts.condition: the submitted bundle lacks an exact referenced release
error_contracts.caller_action: repair the exported dependency closure before replay

error_contracts.condition: the target Registry already contains the same release identity with different bytes
error_contracts.caller_action: use a new immutable release version or restore identical content

logical_modules.responsibility: Own the single code-level classification of model invocation operation IDs and derive the exact non-model operation set consumed by Registry authoring and Execution admission.
failure_and_recovery: an invalid model-operation cardinality fails before Profile compatibility and produces no ModuleExport

logical_modules.responsibility: Compile one exact Module source and validate Module-to-Execution-Profile capability closure without role-specific tool rules.
failure_and_recovery: profile mismatch produces no Variant binding and no Registry mutation
future_capabilities: additional Module roles consume the same capability closure

logical_modules.responsibility: Represent one Workflow as a graph over exact Module releases and export one immutable dependency-closed bundle that is independent of target Runtime identity.
failure_and_recovery: invalid graph closure produces no bundle and no Registry mutation
future_capabilities: hosts may distribute the same export through multiple Runtime clients without changing Workflow identity

logical_modules.responsibility: Register the same exact release bundle independently into each selected Runtime Registry.
failure_and_recovery: one Registry failure does not mutate another Registry

implementation_slices.intended_result: Runtime exports one graph-backed Workflow class, validates generic Module/Profile capability closure, and proves the same immutable Workflow bundle registers unchanged into multiple independent Runtime Registries.
implementation_slices.completion_gate: focused Runtime authoring tests and the full Runtime regression suite pass without Trading Platform code changes, provider calls, network access, or PostgreSQL schema changes

migration_and_compatibility: Remove the tool-free-only rule from ModuleReviewer and replace it with one Module/Profile capability-closure rule shared by every Module role.
Keep existing WorkflowReleaseCandidate and compile_workflow_release identities; Workflow is an authoring facade over those existing contracts, not a second Workflow record family.

ModuleExport is extended to retain the exact Behavior, Evaluation and Retry Policy releases plus fixed Schema/Prompt/Module closure needed to build a fresh Registry origin bundle; optional Execution Profile and Variant records remain separate from that fixed closure.

WorkflowReleaseCandidate.execution_binding_ref is derived only from workflow_id and workflow_version. Its execution_binding_document has exactly schema_version=workflow_execution_binding_v1, the matching workflow_id and variant_policy_family=execution_variant_policy, with no additional fields. Target Runtime, Execution Profile and exact Variant Policy identity therefore cannot enter WorkflowRelease identity.

WorkflowExport carries only the fixed origin closure: Schema, Prompt, Behavior, Evaluation, Retry, Module and Workflow releases. It excludes Execution Profile and Execution Variant Policy releases so each Runtime may register different execution bindings without changing Workflow identity.

Within the origin bundle, identical ref/hash records are included once even when several graph nodes reuse one Module; a duplicate ref with different hash fails in runtime_workflow_authoring before bundle construction.

Keep RuntimeReleaseRegistry registration unchanged; multi-Runtime distribution means replaying the same immutable origin export into independent Registry instances, then registering target-local Profile and Variant Policy releases, not adding a cross-Registry coordinator.
Trading Platform plugin migration remains a later host-owned change and receives no compatibility shim in Runtime.
rollback_boundary: Before commit, restore only the Slice 2E authoring and test paths. After commit, revert the Slice 2E commit; Registry schema, persisted releases, active pointers and Trading Platform sources remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: ModuleReviewer contains no Reviewer-specific tool-free restriction; every Module role uses the same Profile compatibility rule.

The Runtime Module contract owns one shared model-operation classification consumed by authoring and Execution; every Module declares exactly one model operation and derives one exact non-model operation set.

A Profile cannot grant an undeclared tool, omit a declared non-model operation, or use a transport absent from the Module release declaration. An incompatible supplied Profile produces no ModuleExport and no Variant binding; an absent optional Profile produces a non-executable ModuleExport with MODULE_EXECUTION_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE.
Execution adapter admission remains owned by the existing Execution and Invocation path; authoring validates closure without admitting a provider adapter.
Workflow is a Runtime public class backed by one exact graph and exact ModuleExport values.

Workflow compilation rejects any execution binding ref or document that can carry target Runtime, Execution Profile or exact Execution Variant Policy identity; changing target-local Profile or Variant records leaves WorkflowRelease ref and hash unchanged.
WorkflowExport contains one canonical origin RuntimeReleaseBundle with no target Runtime identity, Execution Profile or Execution Variant Policy and no duplicate conflicting release identity.
The same WorkflowExport registers unchanged into at least two independent RuntimeReleaseRegistry instances.

Each target Registry keeps its own active pointer and may register a different Execution Profile and Execution Variant Policy for the same Workflow release; selecting or binding one Registry does not change another.
No Trading Platform source, provider adapter, network client, PostgreSQL schema or compatibility shim changes in this Slice.
Independent engineering review accepts the exact implementation candidate.
